MATLAB

MATLAB supports numerical computing, data analysis, algorithm development and engineering visualisation.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Analyse an engineering dataset

Use the selected equations, data, parameters and units. In the intended MATLAB preview, analyse an engineering dataset; the visible result is a reproducible model or calculation with declared inputs visible. Review dimensions, assumptions, data quality and numerical range before accepting or exporting it.

Develop a numerical algorithm

Start from the operating case, solver settings or experiment space. In the intended MATLAB preview, develop a numerical algorithm; the visible result is computed signals, candidates or numerical results linked to each parameter. Review stability, convergence, sensitivity and expected behaviour before accepting or exporting it.

Publish a reproducible result

Begin with the checked plots, tables and requirement references. In the intended MATLAB preview, publish a reproducible result; the visible result is a reviewable notebook, worksheet or result package. Review units, reproducibility, traceability and engineering interpretation before accepting or exporting it.
